newsitem.title: Estonia: NEW GOVT BEING PRESENTED TO PRESIDENT FRIDAY.
newsitem.headline: NEW GOVT BEING PRESENTED TO PRESIDENT FRIDAY.

text.p: Estonia's nominated prime minister Mart Siimann was meeting President Lennart Meri at 1900/1700 GMT on Friday to present his proposed new government, a spokesman for the president's office said.
"He is seeing the president now and the meeting should finish at 1945/1745 GMT," spokesman Andres Noormets told Reuters.
Siimann was on Wednesday given the authority by parliament to form a new government which had to be presented to the president within seven days.
Within three days of approving the line-up, the president must appoint Siimann prime minister and his ministers to government.
No major changes are expected to the cabinet however the Education Minister Rein Loik has resigned for personal reasons and the position of Agriculture Minister is under question.

The previous prime minister, Tiit Vaehi, resigned last month after narrowly surviving a vote of no confidence amid allegations that he took part in shady privisation deals involving real estate in central Tallinn.
Siimann, a former televsion and radio station manager, has pleged to continue the previous government's reforms. -- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom +372 630 8400, reuters@reuters.ee
